About Me

Who I Am

Hi, I'm Gaurab Barakoti from Nepal. I work as a professional bartender while pursuing my passion for technology, web development, artificial intelligence, and digital content creation.

I am the founder of TRIDEV CORE HQ, a multi-platform content brand where I create engaging content about Nepal, technology, Sanatan Dharma, history, world events, and educational topics.

Alongside my hospitality experience and mixology expertise, I enjoy building websites, learning new technologies, and creating useful digital projects that make a real impact.

My Philosophy

I believe in continuous learning, creativity, professionalism, and delivering quality in everything I do. Whether it's crafting the perfect cocktail or building innovative digital solutions, excellence is my standard.
